title: Shipping & Returns

seo.description: Delivery times, fees, and our returns policy.

body:
## Delivery

- **Delivery fee:** shown at checkout before you pay.
- **When it ships:** we start preparing your order once your PayNow payment is confirmed, and message you on WhatsApp when it’s on its way.
- **Personalised blends** are made to order, so they take a little longer than signature blends.

## Returns & exchanges

Because fragrance is a personal-care product, we can’t accept returns of opened bottles. Personalised blends are made specially for you and can’t be returned or exchanged.

If your order arrives damaged or isn’t what you ordered, message us on WhatsApp with a photo and we’ll make it right.

## Questions

WhatsApp us or email chuwu.fragrance@gmail.com.
